question: Approve entering ideation? (--where robustness: field-name validation/GH #314, archived-inclusive sprint queries, and status --help discoverability)

artifacts.summary: Backlog stub, 3 gaps on one surface: (1) --where silently matches-all on unknown/misspelled field (GH #314) instead of erroring; (2) --where sprint=X excludes done/archived so a full-sprint view forces a grep of _archive/; (3) --where is under-documented in status --help and the FO contract, so the FO reflexively greps instead of querying. 4 ACs proposed (field-validation error, archived-inclusive query, status --help/FO-contract discoverability, go test ./internal/status green).
